'''Klin Kartoosh''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who dealt in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-running racket. Kartoosh operated in the [[Annoo system/Legends|Annoo system]] and was a known associate of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the famous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who had been hired by [[Sise Fromm]], an [[Annoo-dat]] criminal who wished to make a name for himself quickly. Because of Kartoosh's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], Fromm attracted the wrath of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], influent crime boss and [[Kajidii/Legends|leader]] of the Desilijic.
